definitions.explanation: The contrast or range between cold and hot temperatures. Used in technical, engineering, and everyday contexts to discuss temperature fluctuations and their effects on materials or environments.

examples.japanese: {冷熱|れいねつ}の{差|さ}が{激|はげ}しい。
examples.english: The difference between cold and heat is extreme.

examples.japanese: この{素材|そざい}は{冷熱|れいねつ}に{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: This material is resistant to thermal variation.

examples.japanese: {冷熱|れいねつ}サイクル{試験|しけん}で{製品|せいひん}の{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: We verify product durability through thermal cycling tests.

notes:
A compound of {冷|れい} (cold) and {熱|ねつ} (heat). This is an example of a paired-opposite compound ({対義|たいぎ}{複合語|ふくごうご}), similar to {寒暖|かんだん} (cold and warm). Frequently appears in engineering and materials science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷熱|れいねつ}サイクル: thermal cycle
- {冷熱|れいねつ}{試験|しけん}: thermal test
- {冷熱|れいねつ}の{差|さ}: temperature difference
- {冷熱|れいねつ}に{強|つよ}い: resistant to temperature extremes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寒暖|かんだん}: cold and warm — refers to atmospheric temperature variation, as in weather or seasonal changes
- {温度|おんど}: temperature — the measurement of heat itself
- {温冷|おんれい}: warm and cold — used in contexts like alternating hot and cold baths ({温冷|おんれい}{浴|よく})
